action.command: cd /workspace && docker compose ps --format 'table {{.Name}}\t{{.Status}}' && echo "=== ML health ===" && docker compose exec -T backend node -e 'fetch("http://ml-service:8000/health").then(r=>r.text()).then(t=>console.log(t.slice(0,200))).catch(e=>console.log("ERR",e.message))'

tool_call.name: terminal
